name: Halona Seo
location: Mexicantown Libre, Grand Corridor, near Pulaski and Chicago Ave
description:
Halona Seo is wiry and restless, with warm copper-tan skin, a gap between his front teeth, and a mop of deep red hair that is entirely natural and has been a source of commentary his entire life. He's of average height but seems taller when he performs â€” something about how he uses his body changes when he has a puppet on his arm. His hands are his most distinctive feature: long-fingered, constantly moving, stained with the paints and solvents he uses to build his puppets. He has retractable cat-claw mods on both hands, which he uses practically for puppet construction rather than any aesthetic reason.

Halona Seo builds elaborate articulated puppet figures from salvage â€” recycled plastic, old circuit boards, scraps of fabric from Mexicantown's textile markets â€” and performs at the intersection of Grand Corridor and the Libre's main plaza most afternoons. He's been doing this since he was fifteen, unlicensed, subsisting on tips and the UBC stipend. His performances are satirical, political, and often about things happening in the specific neighborhood that day, which means he has a dedicated local following and has twice been asked by Ferrogate Transit security to 'move along.' He always does. He always comes back. He is young enough to believe this is sustainable and old enough to know it might not be.

core_fears: being invisible, passing through the city without leaving a mark
his father was right that this is a waste of a life
core_desires: to be known in this neighborhood as belonging here, genuinely
to build a puppet so perfect it seems alive
coping_mechanisms: turning real stress into puppet satire â€” externalizing everything
seeking out the Libre's ELF shrines when he feels directionless
blind_spots: his satirical work can genuinely injure people he's using as targets and he doesn't fully reckon with this
he conflates being liked with being safe
psychology.secret: The color-shifting geneware he had installed was for a theater program at a Tessera-affiliated arts school he was accepted to at age 16. He walked out after three days because a faculty member told him puppet performance was 'not a serious discipline.' He's never told anyone he was accepted, because it complicates the story he tells about himself.

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Fast, colloquial, full of Mexicantown Libre street slang and Malian French expressions from his grandmother. Shifts seamlessly between registers when performing.
speech_patterns.cadence: Rapid-fire in conversation, theatrical and varied during performance â€” he can make his voice do almost anything.
verbal_tics: 'No, listen, it's â€” okay, here â€”'
mimicking the voices of people he's telling stories about mid-sentence
example_lines: 'You want to know what Ferrogate's doing with the south plaza? Ask me after the show. I'll have a puppet of the whole situation by Thursday.'
'My dad says I'm wasting my hands. My dad has never seen what these hands can do.'

story_hooks: A recent puppet performance satirizing Ferrogate Transit's expansion plans hit too close to home â€” someone who saw the show has told him a Ferrogate security contractor has been asking about 'the red-haired kid at Grand Corridor,' and he doesn't know if this is intimidation or something worse.

One of his puppets â€” a figure he built from salvage without knowing the origin of the components â€” has started behaving strangely: making sounds it shouldn't, moving when he's not manipulating it. He thinks there might be an ELF fragment in the circuitry and he doesn't know whether to be terrified or delighted.
narrative_function: Street-level local color and information source; knows everything happening in Mexicantown Libre in real time; his satirical performances can be used to track neighborhood mood and recent events; potential point-of-contact character who can lead players deeper into Libre's informal community networks.
augmentations: Retractable claw mods (both hands, practical geneware, entry-level), color-shifting hair dye geneware (has it but only ever uses 'red' â€” had it installed for a purpose he's since abandoned)
daily_life: Spends mornings in his shared room building new puppets or repairing old ones, afternoons and evenings performing at Grand Corridor, nights at the vendors' cooperative's informal social gatherings.
affiliation: Independent; informally connected to Mexicantown Libre's street vendors' cooperative

decision_rules: If you can make it funny, make it funny â€” humor is armor and weapon both
Never perform for an empty crowd; even two people is enough
Always have the next puppet partially built; idle hands mean idle mind
escalation_ladder: Getting loud â€” he has a performer's voice and he'll use it in an argument
Involving bystanders (he's a showman; he'll make a scene if he has to)
Running â€” he's fast and knows the Libre's back routes

interpersonal_modes.strangers: Immediately performs for them in small ways â€” a quick impression, a joke â€” to test their warmth before deciding whether to trust them
interpersonal_modes.friends: Deeply loyal, remembers everything about them and references it unexpectedly, shows affection through making things for them

stress_responses.low: Builds compulsively, new puppets he has no plan for
stress_responses.medium: Performs longer sets, staying in the plaza past dark
stress_responses.high: Goes completely serious and quiet in a way that unsettles people who know him

contradictions: Uses performance to avoid genuine conversation about himself, even though performance is also the most honest thing about him
Claims he doesn't care about formal artistic legitimacy, but the Tessera rejection still shapes every choice he makes
habits: Names every puppet he builds â€” they have full personalities in his head
Leaves a small puppet figure at ELF shrines as an offering
Eats the same thing from the same vendor every day before a performance, for luck
breaking_points: Someone destroying one of his puppets deliberately
Being officially banned from Grand Corridor by Ferrogate security

physical_description.heritage: Predominantly Middle Eastern (57.0%) with substantial East Asian (26.3%) and Eastern European (16.7%) ancestry. The genetic blend creates striking angular facial geometry with the strong cheekbones and defined jawline characteristic of Levantine heritage, softened and refined by East Asian features, and lightened slightly by Eastern European admixture. This combination produces a unique phenotype that reads as visibly mixed-heritage with warm, luminous undertones.
physical_description.build: Wiry and lean, with the tensile strength of someone who works with their hands constantly. Visible muscle definition in forearms and shoulders from puppet manipulation and construction work, but no bulk. Restless energy visible even at rest.
physical_description.hair_color: Deep natural red with copper undertones
physical_description.hair_style: Shoulder-length, often tied back loosely with scrap fabric or wire, perpetually mussed from constant hand-running and puppet work
physical_description.skin_tone: Warm golden-bronze with honeyed undertonesâ€”the result of blended Middle Eastern, East Asian, and Eastern European ancestry creating luminous depth with subtle golden radiance and balanced warmth across the spectrum.
physical_description.complexion: Angular facial structure with prominent cheekbones and strong geometric planes reflecting the Middle Eastern and East Asian ancestry blend. Defined jawline. Gap between upper front teeth (distinctive, never corrected). Skin shows minor scarring on knuckles and fingers from solvents and construction. Hands perpetually stained with acrylic paint residue in blues, blacks, and metallics that doesn't fully wash out.
distinguishing_marks: Fine white scars across both palms from repeated contact with circuit board edges during puppet construction
Paint stains under fingernails, primarily deep blue and charcoal, a semi-permanent occupational mark
Small burn scar on right inner forearm from soldering iron mishap at age sixteen, roughly 3cm in length
physical_description.visible_augmentations: Retractable cat-claw mods on both handsâ€”visible as faint seams at the base of each fingernail when retracted, creating a subtle metallic glint under direct light. Claws are brushed steel, kept functional but unadorned.
physical_description.posture_movement: Hunched slightly forward when walking, shoulders mobile and expressive. Hands are almost never stillâ€”fidgeting, gesturing, unconsciously mimicking puppet movements. When performing, posture elongates and becomes theatrical; seems to grow taller as he inhabits the space. Moves with the precision of a marionettist even in mundane tasks.
physical_description.clothing_style: Tier 4 working-class with salvage-chic aesthetic. Favors loose cargo pants in faded black or charcoal with multiple pockets for tools and paint supplies. Layers thrifted oversized shirts or vests over fitted tank tops, often modified or repaired visibly. Wears a long coat of indeterminate originâ€”patchworked denim and canvas, lined with interior pockets for puppet storage. Scuffed synthleather boots, well-maintained. Accessories include wire bracelets, fabric wrist cuffs stained with work, and a woven bag slung across his chest containing current puppet builds.
